title: TopicStatistics
description: Per-topic statistics from a statistics_msgs/MetricsMessage, as reported on the /statistics topic

measurement_source_name.description: Node, topic or process name being measured

metrics_source.description: The measured metric, e.g. the measured topic's name or "message_age"

unit.description: Unit of the statistics, e.g. seconds or ms; empty when the producer left it unset

window_start.description: Start of the window the statistics cover

window_stop.description: End of the window the statistics cover

average.description: Mean over the window; null when the producer did not measure it

minimum.description: Smallest value observed in the window; null when the producer did not measure it

maximum.description: Largest value observed in the window; null when the producer did not measure it

stddev.description: Standard deviation over the window; null when the producer did not measure it

sample_count.description: Messages observed in the window; null when the producer did not report it
